mentions.name: Petra-Bridge
mentions.description: An Obsidian plugin that serves an API which the Petra CLI tool uses to interact with the Obsidian vault, so a Claude Skill can create markdown files in the vault and read from them for context.
mentions.problem: AI assistants like Claude clutter the author's files with random markdown files, so the plugin gives the CLI tool an API to interact with the Obsidian vault instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just a simple Obsidian plugin to serve an API that the CLI tool can use to interact with the Obsidian vault.
